Why is it that, seeing that the times of punishment (; "time" in the same sense) are not hidden from the Almighty, they who know Him (His true worshippers, ) do not see His days (of vengeance; ; )? Or, with Umbreit less simply, making the parallel clauses more nicely balanced, Why are not times of punishment hoarded up ("laid up"; ; appointed) by the Almighty? that is, Why are they not so appointed as that man may now see them? as the second clause shows. Job does not doubt that they are appointed: nay, he asserts it (); what he wishes is that God would let all now see that it is so.
